title: Add file identity to lichend trust recovery errors and surface corrupt floor IO
description: P3 (wave-4 review of worker6-taf3): lichend.rs recover_or_provision_trust_store (~:1131-1167) error strings carried over verbatim from pre-extraction code: 'committed trust provisioning artifacts are missing' does not say WHICH artifact (store lives under state_root, floor under rollback_floor_root), and the (false,true) arm uses load_generation_floor(...).unwrap_or(u64::MAX) so a corrupt/unreadable floor file is misreported as 'orphan trust floor is not the initial generation' instead of surfacing the IO error. Fail-closed either way. Fix: name the artifact+path in each error and distinguish corrupt-floor IO from wrong-generation. Apply the same clarity to the slot path (tracked concern about its pre-gate floor write is separate).
